newsitem.title: USA: United Dominion to post Q3 $9.6 mln gain.
newsitem.headline: United Dominion to post Q3 $9.6 mln gain.

text.p: United Dominion Realty Trust Inc said Monday it would post a $9.6 million gain in the third quarter ending September 30 for selling six properties for $34.7 million.
The trust said it sold six apartment communities containing 1,204 homes, which it bought between 1981 and 1994, to Alliance HD Portfolio LP.
United Dominion added it structured the transaction to qualify as a tax-deferred exchange, and expected to defer most or all of the related capital gain for tax purposes.

The trust sold the following properties: Canterbury Woods in Charlotte, N.C., with 207 homes; Colony of Stone Mountain Atlanta with 404 homes; Indian Hills Anniston, Ala., with 140 homes; Orange Orlando, Orlando, Fla., with 165 homes; River Road Terrace Richmond, Va., with 128 homes; and Timbercreek, Richmond, Va., with 160 homes.
United Dominion owns about 59,000 completed apartment homes in 218 communities and 1,200 apartment homes in developments in 15 Sunbelt states.
